title: WhatsApp Campaigns
notes: Detail drawer intentionally replaced by a dedicated detail route (list rows navigate to /marketing/whatsapp/[id] via onRowClick, matching the campaigns feature pattern) since campaign detail needs full-page analytics + recipients tabs. sendMessageDialog/phoneInput/addressAutocomplete not applicable: outbound sends are template-driven bulk campaign sends via POST /send, not one-off per-contact messages, and there is no phone/address entry field in this slice. currencyInput not applicable: no monetary field on a campaign. Backend contract for WhatsappCampaign/analytics/recipient shapes was inferred from the campaigns.ts sibling feature since no shared type exists yet — worth confirming against actual backend response shape when available.
showcaseScript: Create a campaign from an approved WhatsApp template
Select the recipient segment and send
Open analytics and show delivered, read and replied counts
